definitionZh: 内置的 CSS 短手属性定义了内置方向中一个元素的逻辑起始和结尾抵消,该属性根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向来映射物理抵消. 它与上下或左右属性相对应,取决于为写法模式、方向和文字导向定义的值。
sourceDefinition: The inset-inline CSS shorthand property defines the logical start and end offsets of an element in the inline direction, which maps to physical offsets depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the top and bottom, or right and left properties depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
